sentences.text: No, the documents do not say that a UCB may capitalise or compound penal interest; they say there is no capitalization of the penal charges, i.e., no further interest computed on such charges, and that penal interest is not permitted for this case.
The documents also say additional / fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
The older 2023 circular said normal procedures for compounding of interest in the loan account were not affected, but that document is superseded and no longer in force.
